# iosxe_voice_class_media (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class Media configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_media" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class media tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `anti_trombone` (Boolean) Media Anti-trombone functionality
- `flow` (String) choice of flow case gateway
- `forking` (Boolean) Enable media forking
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `monitor_video` (Boolean) Enable video quality monitoring
- `stats_disconnect` (Boolean) Defer BYE for last call stats at disconnect
